The core tension is the use-of-proceeds split. Victor has confirmed that $10 million must go to refinancing a 2027 debt maturity — that's fixed. That leaves $8 million for environmental projects. And Leah, your redemption protections — make-whole clause and 12-month no-call — are clear and non-negotiable from a legal standpoint. Those will be incorporated regardless of the final maturity.

So the two questions I need answered before I can settle are: (1) Jonas, is a green label viable with only $8 million of $18 million going to green projects under our framework? (2) Maya, can we proceed without the anchor investor if the terms prove unworkable, or are they essential to the book?
